title: Check: Jobs and CronJobs
description: Five questions on running work to completion, and on a schedule.

questions.prompt: Which restartPolicy values are valid in a Job's Pod template?
questions.explanation: `Always` would restart a container that finished successfully, which contradicts running to completion, so the API rejects it for Jobs.

options.text: Five successful completions, at most two running at a time
Two Pods run five times each
Five Pods, two of which may fail

questions.explanation: completions is the total number of successes required; parallelism caps how many run concurrently.

options.text: How long a Pod may run
How many times a Job retries before it is marked failed
How many Jobs a CronJob keeps

questions.explanation: Default 6. `activeDeadlineSeconds` is the one that caps wall-clock duration.

questions.prompt: Write the imperative command that creates a CronJob named report running `date` every five minutes on image busybox.
questions.explanation: Generating it and editing beats writing the YAML by hand under time pressure.

questions.prompt: A CronJob's previous run is still going when the next is due, and you must not have two at once. Which field?
questions.explanation: Forbid skips the new run while one is active. Replace kills the old one; Allow (the default) lets them overlap.
